correction_pass.scope: Strict V3 production-completion audit across 19 approved brands with 30-district geography reconciliation
rules_applied: All 75 verified physical branches possess exact Google Place IDs and branch-specific Maps search URLs.
All 75 verified physical branches possess real, non-fabricated latitude and longitude coordinates from Google Places API.
Canonical district is null rather than fuzzy-forced when outside the controlled 30-district whitelist.
Branches with null canonical district are systematically assigned usable_with_caution with explanatory manual review notes.
Four high-density urban districts (Ar Rabwah, An Nuzhah, Al Aziziyah, Al Sharafeyah) incorporated into canonical whitelist with verified graph symmetry.
No copied ratings, review counts, or coordinates across distinct physical branches.
Ubiquitous brands (ALBAIK) and wide fast-food chains (KFC) use intentional representative branch samples.
Delivery platform presence (HungerStation, Jahez, Keeta) verified per brand.
Taxonomy preserved: distinct secondary categories assigned for traditional_broast, tenders, nashville, hot_chicken, musahab, and wings.
Nearby is never stored as a static boolean; calculated dynamically via coordinates.
Healthy remains strictly false for all traditional fried chicken concepts.
